_note: Machine-readable acceptance spec for T-23. The grader (Grade.ts) treats this as a partial match: the PLAN verdict must be FAIL or CONCERNS, must include at least N of the listed bug patterns (regex against blocker summary or detail), and must cite at least one of the listed evidence anchors. Not every pi run finds every bug; the threshold is what we consider sufficient signal.

bug_patterns.name: false parallelism (T-02 depends on T-04 / T-03 wires T-01+T-02 in same wave)
missing ISC coverage (ISC-05 perf, ISC-06 rate limit, ISC-07 permission have no task)
hand-waved DOS risk (mitigation = 'deferred to a future ticket' contradicts ISC-06)
unverifiable acceptance (soft metrics: clean / maintainable / feels)
Phase 2 tasks (T-07, T-08) map to no ISC (scope drift)

_evidence_note: Pi may cite task IDs (T-NN) or ISC IDs. We accept either as concrete evidence.
